_meta.tool: get_trade_call (+ get_trade_signal alias — same producer getTradeSignal)
_meta.transport: MCP Streamable-HTTP POST https://api.algovault.com/mcp (tools/call) + stdio + x402 paid route + okx a2mcp + Virtuals ACP (all via callCoreHandler)
_meta.purpose: Public-response-shape SoT after `reasoning` and `_receipts` were collapsed onto ONE factor ledger. Supersedes get-trade-call-shape-snapshot-2026-06-27.json and CARRIES FORWARD its central finding, which this wave acted on: the internal `oiScore` is derived from 24h PRICE change, and `indicators.oi_change_pct` enters NO verdict score. The 06-27 snapshot recorded that fact; `_receipts.factors[]` nevertheless kept shipping `oi_change_pct` with a verdict `direction`, so an agent reading a direction inferred a reason that did not exist. `factor_ledger[].contributes` now states it in the payload.

allowed_keys_exempt_reason: allowed_keys DEFERRED, not invented — carried forward VERBATIM in force from get-trade-call-shape-snapshot-2026-06-27.json, because the reason is still true: this is an MCP tool whose public response is CONDITIONAL (verdict, tier and flag state change which fields are present), so a single live probe cannot settle a COMPLETE allow-list, and an incomplete one published to crawlers is worse than an empty one because it looks authoritative. NARROWED by this wave: the `_receipts` sub-surface IS now enumerable, because R2 shipped an exported pure formatter (`formatReceipts` + `formatFactorLedger` in src/lib/receipts.ts) whose output is an explicit field copy rather than a spread — that enumeration is recorded below as `receipts_allowed_keys` and `factor_ledger_row_allowed_keys`. The remaining gap is the TOP-LEVEL envelope. Owner unchanged: OPS-SHAPE-ALLOWLIST-FROM-FORMATTER-W{NEXT}.

reasoning_contract.shape: EXACTLY 3 sentences joined by '. ', whole string <= 280 characters, terminal period.
reasoning_contract.why_280: Set by the CONSUMER, not by taste: algovault-bot renders `reasoning[:280]` (alert_engine.py), so a longer string is cut mid-word in front of a real user. The prior bound was an unexercised <=500 against a ~700-char 5-slot template.
reasoning_contract.why_period_delimited: The verdict card and the bot's `_bulletize_reasoning` both split on '. '. Keeping the delimiter means ZERO renderer changes on any surface.
slots: 1 DRIVER — the top-ranked ledger row that CONTRIBUTES and whose direction agrees with the net. There is deliberately no fallback to 'top directional row': that would let the counterweight be narrated as the reason.
2 CONTEXT-OR-COUNTERWEIGHT — a real opposing contributor ('Against: …'), else the largest DORMANT contributor, else regime/open-interest/volatility as context.
3 FLIP — what would change the call, named from the ledger. Never a numeric threshold unless read from a code constant.
reasoning_contract.number_rule: Every number in the string is reproducible from a value emitted in the SAME response under a closed set of projections, or is a code constant passed explicitly (FUNDING_Z_WINDOW_DAYS, PRICE_CHANGE_WINDOW_HOURS). This REPLACED a blanket `/\d+\.\d+/` ban and is strictly stronger: the old rule permitted any integer (a fabricated '62% conviction cap' passed it) while forbidding `-0.0066%` even though `funding_rate: -0.00006641` shipped two fields away in the same JSON.
never: a direction arrow on a factor with contributes=false — an arrow is a causal claim
a claim that any factor caps conviction — regime enters NEITHER the verdict NOR the confidence (VerdictGateInputs has no regime field; thresholds are per-timeframe)
'normal' or 'no factor cleared its threshold' over a funding row with too little history — both assert a measurement that was never taken
a component score, a weight coefficient, or any outcome_* field

receipts_change.factors: DEPRECATED — superseded by factor_ledger. FROZEN BYTE-IDENTICAL this wave: same 1..3 rows, same selection rule, same order, same direction/value wire format. Frozen rather than widened because BOTH digest renderers take `factors.slice(0, 3)` (src/lib/scan-digest.ts and the Python mirror algovault-bot/scan_digest.py) — re-ranking or lengthening it would silently rewrite every Telegram scan line ever sent. Retirement is its own release wave with a cache-refresh notice: OPS-RECEIPTS-FACTORS-RETIRE-W{NEXT}.
receipts_change.factor_ledger: NEW additive array. Every public indicator as a signed row with `contributes` + `strength`. PRESENT only when the caller supplies a ledger — get_trade_call does; the scan-digest enrichment path deliberately does not, which is what keeps its frozen byte-equality fixtures and tests/unit/receipts.test.ts passing UNMODIFIED.
receipts_change.stripped_remainder: NEW additive object {count, net}. The moat-1-stripped contributors accounted for as a COUNT and a net sign, never their names. Half the score weight (rsi 30% + volume 20%) has no public counterpart, so without this the ledger would silently fail to add up.
receipts_change.no_rank: `rank` exists on the INTERNAL ledger and is stripped by the public formatter. Across many observations a rank is an ordinal projection of the weight vector, which is an INTERNAL data class. `strength` is safe because it is scaled to the largest contribution in the SAME call, so it conveys within-call ordering and no coefficient.
receipts_change.verdict_unchanged: call + confidence + regime + price + indicators are BYTE-IDENTICAL. No score, weight or threshold was touched; only how the result is DESCRIBED.

indicators_conditional.oi_change_pct: present iff the oi_snapshots store is warm for (coin, exchange)
indicators_conditional.funding_note: present iff the TradFi/pre-IPO funding annotation applies

which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.note: CARRIED FORWARD AND EXTENDED from the 06-27 snapshot. A public indicator is not the same thing as a scored input, and conflating the two is what produced the mislabelling this wave retires.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.funding_rate: YES — the 25% funding term, plus the funding-z adjustments (contributes=true)
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.regime: YES via the 10% EMA term, but ONLY when their signs agree. Measured: regime can never carry the OPPOSITE sign to emaScore, but RANGING absorbs a bullish cross at RSI>=70, a bearish cross at RSI<=30, and any null RSI — on that divergence the row renders as context and the EMA contribution moves to stripped_remainder.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.trend_persistence: YES via the Hurst ADJUSTMENT, not a weight term. An AMPLIFIER: it scales whatever the net already is, so it carries no direction of its own and can never be a driver or a counterweight.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.breakout_pending: YES via the squeeze ADJUSTMENT. Also an amplifier.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.oi_change_pct: NO — contributes=false. It comes from computeOiDelta and enters no score. The 15% term named `oiScore` internally reads 24h PRICE change.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.volume_24h: NO — contributes=false. The scored volume term reads a per-bar candle-volume ratio, a different quantity.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.funding_24h_avg: NO — a literal alias of funding_rate.
which_indicators_drive_the_verdict.underlying_session: NO — drives only the market-closed caveat.

cache_contract.response: NOT cached. Every tools/call recomputes the verdict from live adapter reads; there is no HTTP cache header and no response memo.
cache_contract.funding_z_stats: per-coin (mean, stdDev, sampleCount) cached 5 minutes in-process (FUNDING_STATS_TTL_MS). The underlying 14-day window moves on the order of hours, so the TTL is invisible to signal quality.
cache_contract.track_record: the _receipts.track_record block is served from the in-process cache behind performance://signal-performance and is OMITTED entirely (fail-open) when that source is momentarily unavailable — never a stale hardcoded value.
cache_contract.top20_by_oi: 1 hour, used only by the asset-tier classifier.
cache_contract.cross_asset_grid: TTL-cached and promise-coalesced; feeds only the additive closest_tradeable / also_see fields and never the verdict.
cache_contract.stateless_transport: the remote MCP transport is stateless (sessionIdGenerator undefined), so nothing about this response depends on a prior request.

error_contract.TIER_LIMIT_REACHED: TierLimitReachedError — structured, carries currentUsage/monthlyLimit/tier/suggestedUpgradeUrl/resetAtMs/referralCode. Every successful verdict counts as one metered call, HOLD included (PRICING-FLAT-CALL-BILLING-AND-6MONTH-W1 R-A); errors are not verdicts and are never charged. Two independent meters — the refusal carries `limit: 'daily'|'monthly'`.
error_contract.TRADFI_SYMBOL_UNSUPPORTED_ON_VENUE: TradFiSymbolUnsupportedOnVenueError — carries suggested_venues so an agent can self-retry.
error_contract.free_tier_gate: a plain Error carrying freeGateMessage(coin, timeframe) when the coin or timeframe is outside the caller's tier.
error_contract.degradation: an oi_snapshots failure OMITS oi_change_pct rather than emitting a stale or wrong-signed value, and never fails the verdict. Same fail-soft contract for the track record.

additive_and_correction_rule: factor_ledger + stripped_remainder are ADDITIVE; factors[] is frozen byte-identical and marked DEPRECATED; `reasoning` changes CONTENT but not SHAPE (still '. '-delimited, so every renderer is untouched). Emitting a direction arrow for a contributes=false factor, publishing `rank` or any coefficient, or letting the prose name a factor the ledger does not contain with the sign the ledger assigned = Factuality/Data-Integrity violation → HALT.
superseded_reason: Superseded by SIGNAL-LEDGER-INTEGRITY-W1. This snapshot documented a correct `reasoning` projection over a ledger whose OWN fields were defective: `contributes` was derived per response at three sites so it varied for a structural property, `strength` could contradict `direction` (a live row read neutral AND dominant), and `stripped_remainder.count` moved 1,1,1,2 under a label that reads as a fixed cardinality. Three of the four trace to an AMBIGUOUS SPEC rather than to bad code — this file's own D7 defined the withheld count without ruling on whether a neutral withheld row counted. The successor carries every finding here forward and declares the wiring in code (VERDICT_INPUT_CHANNELS) so the table and the implementation cannot drift.
